sampling: Seeded area-uniform annular candidate pools, greedy farthest-point selection within declared radial and angular-quadrant quotas for validation/new test. Preserve old validation and test; retain old train only if outside holdout buffer. All eight headings stay in one partition. Quadrants progress counterclockwise from positive world X.
normalization: Train the unchanged network against body-frame home-vector targets divided by scale. Deployment multiplies network outputs by scale to return meters. No clipping, augmentation, AMP, LR schedule or pretrained weights.
selection: Select minimum full-validation physical component MSE among epoch endpoints, independently per arm; freeze both selections before opening either test partition. Also report final epoch150 and the predeclared19950-update checkpoint. Compare arms on the same samples and initialization.
execution: One Isaac process for capture, then sequential offline training arms to bound memory. Validation once per epoch. Smoke runs use fresh independent models and never seed formal weights.
limits: Same-scene position holdout, overlapping camera footprints possible. Legacy test is a development comparison. New test is held closed until both arms finish; no cross-scene or closed-loop success claim. More data also increases the150-epoch update budget;19950-step checkpoints provide an additional matched-budget comparison.
